All experiments are conducted using the Transformers library via HuggingFace. For the experiments, we searched for a learning rate out of $\{1\mathrm{e} - 5,2\mathrm{e} - 5,$ $3\mathrm{e} - 5,5\mathrm{e} - 5\}$ and the number of epochs out of $\{1,2,$ $3,4,5\}$ . We kept the batch size fixed at 32 for training, 64 for validation. We report a mean score of 5 runs. The experiments are conducted on GeForce RTX 2080 Ti 10GB, with 10.2 CUDA version. The single experiment takes from an hour to 4 hours. The number of parameters for BERT base model is 110 million, 123 million for RoBERTa base and 354 million for RoBERTa large.
